studio-forest-heart.note: Exact full-round model with server entropy census, independent seeded start/move replay and real PostgreSQL common-wallet qualification. Presentation reads only the confirmed public view. Browser, module, layout and audio checks are recorded separately from mathematical qualification.

studio-caribbean-treasures.note: One stake funds the whole ordinary round. Exact nonnegative rewards and all free continuations are accumulated, capped at the existing maximum and settled once with an independent unbiased integer-cent ticket. Accepted historical rounds retain their original settlement. Qualification is mandatory; no frozen baseline or proof is waived.

studio-neopolis.samplingPlan: Retain the complete first 10000 cycles per seed and extend each stream to exactly 30000 cycles once. Use a two-sided 97.5% normal interval for each of the at most two looks. Do not stop early or discard any seed or prefix. Keep the failed first-look evidence. No further sample extension is authorized by this plan.

studio-wild-nudge.note: Exact full-round expectation plus exhaustive cyclic-stop server census, independent seeded full-round replay, reachable maximum on every stake and real PostgreSQL common-wallet concurrency/recovery/rollback qualification. Client layout and media are verified separately.

royal-coins.note: Exact exhaustive paid and promotional nominal qualification. Reward player cost is zero; expected promotional payout is not reported as RTP. Common-wallet accounting is verified separately by progression-spins tests.
